units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale
background: pure white (segmentation video); only objects and some ground pieces are visible

camera.evidence: phase correlation of 3 static patches vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.53 px all frames (camera_shift.csv)
camera.perspective: 3D, camera looks down onto the ground; far objects higher in image (green sedan bottom y=415, ground patches y~270-345), near objects low (purple sedan, sidewalk). Horizon is above the frame top. Car long axes on the ground: purple sedan -15 deg, green sedan -7 deg, van 32-35 deg (image angles, y down). The van approaching the camera grows 4.5x in length (173->774 px), cyclist ~3x, taxi grows and rotates, pedestrian ~constant (bh 91->100 px).

pedestrian.desc: walking man, light-grey top, dark trousers; upper-left middle of frame, walks right-to-left (image), roughly parallel to the image plane, slightly toward camera
pedestrian.ref_point: mask centroid cx,cy ~ pelvis/hip height (sim origin = pelvis); bbox y0 = head top, y1 = lowest foot

taxi.desc: yellow taxi (roof sign), starts left of the van facing the camera, turns to its right (image: heads toward camera then leftward) and ends side-on above the purple sedan
taxi.ref_point: mask centroid (vehicle root ~ centre of body); bbox, L = length along principal axis

van.desc: white cargo van (Chevrolet-style, red-brown windows), starts top-centre, drives toward the camera down-right along image direction ~32 deg below +x, strongly growing (4.5x)
van.ref_point: mask centroid of the van silhouette (cyclist pixels removed)

cyclist.desc: person in dark jacket and blue jeans on a black bicycle, rides alongside the van on its left (image: in front of the van lower-left corner), same direction as the van
cyclist.ref_point: mask centroid of bike+legs (head/shoulders often missing, see head_top_y); bottom_y = lowest wheel point

ground_patch_right.desc: flat brown rectangular ground patch, far upper right

ground_patch_left.desc: flat brown/red rectangular ground patch (manhole/mat), left of the green sedan

purple_sedan.desc: large purple/violet sedan, lower-left foreground, parked, cut by the left image edge (x=3); a translucent grey human-like figure is rendered inside it near the windshield (x~380-450, y~650-760), static

sidewalk_corner.desc: beige paved sidewalk corner with a white line/slot, bottom centre, cut by the bottom edge

events.what: frames 0 and 1 are almost identical (all objects step <= 0.6 px); motion of every moving object starts between frame 1 and 2 (t=0.042-0.083 s)
start of motion (all four moving objects)

taxi turns: image direction of motion ~117-135 deg (toward camera, down-left) at frames 6-12, then 150-160 deg by frame 24-36 and ~170 deg (leftward) after frame 54; its principal axis rotates from +36 deg (seen nose-on) to -12 deg (side view)
van: monotonically accelerating in image (centroid step 0.2 px/frame at f1 to 67 px/frame at f70), straight line ~32 deg

cyclist: straight path ~37 deg, image speed 3-5 px/frame early to ~25 px/frame at end; moves from beside the van rear-left (f0) to ahead of its front-left wheel (f20+); overlaps the van in image every frame
pedestrian walks steadily leftward, ~3.6 px/frame centroid (gait jitter +-1.5 px)
pedestrian bbox touches taxi bbox in image (pedestrian feet just above taxi roof); masks stay separate; no contact
no bounces, impacts or releases observed
